propositions: Eight CI lanes lacked per-test hang guards (--timeout and --timeout-method=thread), allowing deadlocked tests to hide behind final output with no traceback or culprit identification.

External integration and live-service lanes (llm_live, external Jira Cloud, Langfuse trace, Jira DC harness) needed calibrated per-test budgets derived from historical Action run durations rather than a uniform timeout.

The parity assertion in test_ci_workflow_parity.py was blind to non-xdist lanes and pytest invocation forms (bare pytest, python -m pytest, path-prefixed variants), requiring a new exhaustive sweep with a shell-comment-aware detection rule.
Structured-output-baseline's single test driving the sweep needed 3600s budget (20x worst observation) to accommodate intentional human-dispatched calls exceeding the offline observed maximum.
Per-lane timeouts were added: 900s (llm_live, Jira DC), 600s (Jira Cloud, test.yml external), 300s (Langfuse, offline lanes), and 3600s (structured-output-baseline).
The _optionality.yml degradation-path clean venv required pytest-timeout explicitly installed to honor the new per-test timeout flag in a minimal environment.
